course.description: Unit 3 Places we live in--Lesson C-【例句】

sentences.content: What is in your dream community?
sentences.english: What is in your dream community ?
sentences.chinese: 你梦想中的社区是什么样的？

sentences.content: There is a shop in our dream community. People can go shopping there.
sentences.english: There is a shop in our dream community . People can go shopping there
sentences.chinese: 我们梦想的社区里有一家商店。人们可以在那里购物。

sentences.content: There is a playground. Children can have fun there.
sentences.english: There is a playground . Children can have fun there
sentences.chinese: 那里有一个游乐场。孩子们可以在那里玩耍。

sentences.content: This is my dream community. There is ... People often ...
sentences.english: This is my dream community . There is ... People often ...
sentences.chinese: 这是我梦想中的社区。这里有... 人们常常...

sentences.content: I can tell people about places in my community.
sentences.english: I can tell people about places in my community
sentences.chinese: 我可以向人们介绍我所在社区的一些地方。

sentences.content: I can say what people do in my community.
sentences.english: I can say what people do in my community
sentences.chinese: 我可以讲述我们社区里人们的日常活动。

sentences.content: I can say why I like a place in my community.
sentences.english: I can say why I like a place in my community
sentences.chinese: 我可以说明为什么喜欢社区里的某个地方。

sentences.content: I can read and spell words with "ck".
sentences.english: I can read and spell words with " ck "
sentences.chinese: 我能够认读和拼写含有"ck"的单词。
